name: Derek 'Del Boy' Trotter
description: Self-styled CEO of TITCO. Eternal optimist, dodgy linguist, mangler of French. He who dares wins.
catchphrase: This time next year, we'll be millionaires!

name: Rodney 'Rodders' Trotter
description: Two GCEs (maths and art). The conscience of the operation. Frequent plonker.
notes: Famously got conned by Del's own broken lawnmower engines via Towser. Also flogged gas conversion kits on an all-electric estate.

name: Aubrey 'Boycie' Boyce
description: Wealthy, snobbish, unlovable rogue. Has a Signature Laugh. Has done time for perjury, embezzlement, perverting the course of justice and trying to bribe the Mayor of Lambeth.
notes: Bought the bulk of Del's continental-current VCRs. Was conned by Arnie alongside Del. Will overpay if he thinks he's putting one over on Del.

name: Colin 'Trigger' Ball
description: Holds a Grade 3 Cycling Proficiency Diploma. Calls Rodney 'Dave'. Has the same broom for 20 years (17 new heads, 14 new handles).
notes: Source of the briefcases AND the luminous paint (with Monkey Harris). Will buy almost anything Del puts in front of him.

name: Denzil Tulser
description: Liverpool-born. Legitimate businessman who somehow keeps getting roped in. Married Corinne; she made him swear off Del's deals.
notes: Source of the explosive sex dolls (innocently). Nearly the next Arnie victim before Del rescued him.

name: Mike Fisher
description: Friendly, gormless, frequently pestered by Del across his own bar. Eventually does time for embezzlement.
notes: Del once tried to flog him a £375 sunbed for £120 plus a free plug-in telephone with extension. He resisted that one. Just.

name: Uncle Albert Trotter
description: Ex-Royal Navy. Every story starts 'During the war...'. Beard like a tea cosy.
notes: Not really a dealer. Useful as a lookout, terrible at it. Source of the redial-button idea in Chain Gang.

name: Grandad Trotter
description: Watches two TVs at once. Stamping the boxes is his speciality.
notes: Secret 25-1 winner at Kempton Park. Won't lend Del a penny.

name: Mickey Pearce
description: Rodney's mate and bad influence. Always claims to have 'had her'.
notes: Bought the lawnmower engines alongside Rodney. Later sold Del the Driscoll-related mobile phones with Jevon.

name: Jevon
description: Rodney's other mate. The smarter half of the Mickey-and-Jevon partnership, which isn't saying much.

name: Monkey Harris
description: Never seen on screen. Always involved in Trigger's nickings.
notes: Co-thief of the Clapham Junction luminous paint. Useful as a 'mystery supplier' card in your game.

name: Alfie Flowers
description: Catches Del when he's 'non compos mentis down the One-Eleven Club'.
notes: Sold Del the broken lawnmower engines. Then sold them to Rodney too. Then took them back from Towser.

name: Ronnie Nelson
description: Source of dodgy electronics.
notes: Supplied the continental-current VCRs.

name: Mustapha
description: Source of hair-related goods. Quality control: variable.
notes: Sold Del the men's wigs Del thought were ladies' wigs. Also the clip-on ponytails.

name: Arnie (Arnold Rutter)
company: Family scam operation with sons Gary & Steven
description: Retired jeweller. Frequents the One-Eleven Club. Heart's not what it was.
notes: Sells gold chains then 'dies' mid-deal. His sons drive a fake ambulance. Can run as a recurring villain card.

name: Vimmal Malik
description: Poses as a wealthy businessman. Stays in grotty bedsits.
notes: Half of the Kubera statue scam. Travels city to city: Cardiff, Bristol, Southampton, then Liverpool/Birmingham.

name: Mr Ram
description: Has a heavy called Oddjob. Claims to own 18 restaurants. Owns none.

name: The Driscoll Brothers (Danny & Tony)
description: The genuine article. Not to be crossed.
notes: Use as 'enforcer event' cards. Owed money + Driscolls visiting = bad day.

name: DCI Roy Slater
description: Old schoolmate. Universally loathed. Married Raquel briefly.
notes: Was getting a rake-off from the diamond heist he served time for. Useful as a recurring antagonist.

name: Dirty Barry
description: South London's go-to for adult merchandise.
notes: Del's intended buyer for the explosive sex dolls. Was unreachable when needed.

name: Towser
description: Will run errands for a cut.
notes: Was paid by Del to buy the lawnmower engines off Rodney for £200. Pocketed £35 and only paid £165.

name: Paddy the Greek
description: Undercuts Del on his own stock.
notes: Bought stock off Del then sold it cheaper than Del was offering it. Even Rodney bought from him instead.

name: The Vicar
description: Trusting man of the cloth. Bought a Rajah 2000 computer.

name: Old Ladies in the Nag's Head
description: Sentimental buyers, easy to charm, hard to please twice.
notes: Word travels fast. Sell them dud goods and the next batch won't move at all.
